messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: INV-2024-045 • service=inference-runtime • region=eu-west-1 • severity=P1 • symptoms=high token latency + increased 5xx rate. Bridge: <https://zoom.redwood/bridge/INV-2024-045|join> • pager details in incident board.
devon: acknowledging. i'm oncall and joining bridge now. seeing spikes in tail latency and a cluster of OOMs on the ml-runners group.
ashley: also joining — just pulled last deploy, what was the commit?
devon: recent deploy is `model-proxy@b7c9f2` rolled 09:12 UTC. initial hypothesis: new kernel path + longer kv cache mem usage. grabbing logs.
devon: ```
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/model-proxy -c runtime | grep -E "OOMKilled|ERROR" | tail -n 50
# hits: repeated mem alloc failures, gc thrashing, conn reset 502
```
liam: @devon any immediate mitigation? can we scale or roll back? :thinking_face:
devon: spun up 3 extra runners in eu-west-1 (scale +2) and set autoscaler min to 6. latency improved slightly but 5xx still ~2.5%.
ops-bot: Automated action: scale deployment model-proxy replicas from 4 to 6 (initiated by devon).
devon: trying a rollback to `model-proxy@a4d2b1` (previous stable). will keep you posted.
ops-bot: Rollback started by devon: target image model-proxy@a4d2b1. Deployment rollout in progress...
ashley: heads-up: if rollback doesn't fix it, we'll failover traffic to us-east for critical customers.
emily: looping in product ops — can we get an initial customer impact summary? which customers hit 5xxs or slow responses?
devon: quick query shows spike hits concentrated to a small set of customers hitting long sequences (LLMs with long context). approximate impacted requests ~1.2k over 25m window. errors mostly 502/503. adding to incident board.
emily: thanks. I'll notify CSMs for the top 5 customers and prepare a short status note. will include ETA for next update in 30m. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Rollback succeeded, pods at model-proxy@a4d2b1 all Ready=6/6. Observability: 5xx rate decaying toward baseline.
devon: post-rollback: 5xx rate down to 0.4% and token latency p95 dropped ~120ms. marking mitigated. still watching for recurrence for 1h.
ashley: i'll take oncall for the next shift in 40m — handoff on bridge at 11:05 UTC. devon, can you capture any debug snippets that would help RCA?
devon: will dump kv cache stats, memory maps, and GC logs and paste to the incident doc. here's a quick snippet i already saved:
```
2024-06-12T09:18:03Z model-proxy[pid=2378] WARN mem_alloc: request=1.2G available=900M
2024-06-12T09:18:04Z model-proxy[pid=2378] ERROR kv_cache: eviction_failed key=ctx-<redacted>
```
liam: given impact and rollback, we should open a postmortem and assign an RCA owner. i'm available to own the writeup unless someone else prefers.
emily: +1 to liam. i'll peer-review and handle customer impact wording.
ashley: agreed. i'll confirm oncall notes and add the handoff fragment to the timeline.
devon: thanks liam — i've made a minimal timeline in the incident doc (link: <https://docs.redwood/incidents/INV-2024-045|incident doc>) with raw logs and mitigations. please expand.
liam: i'll take ownership. plan: draft RCA with timeline, root causes (regression in kernel path + kv cache mem growth), mitigations, and follow-up action items. ETA: first draft by 2024-06-13 17:00 UTC.
emily: i'll schedule a peer review slot for 2024-06-14 09:00 UTC and invite SRE + Runtime + Product. assigning reviewers: @emily, @ashley, @devon.
ashley: action items from bridge:
- liam: [ ] Draft RCA timeline + contributing factors (ETA 2024-06-13 17:00 UTC)
- devon: [ ] Attach GC logs, kv cache dump, reproducer steps (in progress)
- ops-bot: [ ] Confirm rollback artifact tagging and create a blocked-release tag
- emily: [ ] Draft customer note and notify top 5 CSMs
- ashley: [ ] Oncall handoff note and verify monitoring alerts for regression

devon: added reproducer steps to the doc and a small script for local mem profile. snippet:
```
python tools/mem_repro.py --seed=42 --ctx-size=50000
```
liam: perfect, i'll incorporate and also add a short test plan to avoid regressions in future quantized kernel merges.
emily: one more: let's add a postmortem follow-up meeting in calendar for 2024-06-14 10:30 UTC — 30m slot. i'll create invite.
ashley: i'm good to close the live pager loop from my side once devon confirms stable for 1h. devon: can you set the incident status to 'mitigated' in the board?
devon: status=mitigated in the board and added last check at 10:28 UTC, continuing watch. if no recurrence we'll mark resolved after 60m.
ops-bot: Incident state updated -> mitigated by devon at 2401234610.
liam: noted. i'll start the draft now. tagging this thread for traceability.
emily: thanks everyone. please add any other context to the doc before EOD. i'll kick off the review calendar once draft is up.
ashley: handing off to liam/emily for RCA flow. oncall handover to ashley completed at 11:05 UTC. :handshake:
devon: final note — we should add a short test for kv-cache memory growth under long sequences as part of the follow-up. adding to incident doc.
liam: added follow-up item in draft: implement kv-cache mem regression test + rollout gating for kernel path changes.
emily: closing loop here — last_message: 2401234675. collecting owners for postmortem and next steps.
